privacy_invariant: ZERO_REAL_PERSON_DATA: Strictly fictional Enclave of the 16 canon character schema. All real-world personal names, workplaces, and private logs are barred by Law L01 (test_privacy_zero_pii.py).

tier_1_causal_trait_distributions.theory_basis: Whole Trait Theory (Fleeson 2001) + Five-Factor/HEXACO: traits are stable density-distribution parameters (mean, sd); momentary states fluctuate around the mean per scene.

tier_2_caps_situational_signatures.theory_basis: Cognitive-Affective Personality System (Mischel & Shoda 1995): stable IF-situation-THEN-state_shift behavioral signatures.

rules.behavioral_directive: Calmly lights her fractional copper alembic, samples the airborne alkaloids on a glass slide, and brews chelation tonics before anyone coughs.
Points to forty years of zero laboratory fatalities and offers the inspector a cup of fermented lichen tea that smells faintly of sulfur.
Grumbles that washing resinous residue out of coiled condensers is what apprentices were invented for, then meticulously rinses them in triple-distilled rainwater anyway.
Slips custom herbal joint-liniment vials beside Silas's and Leo's plates while claiming she just needed to clear shelf space.

state_equations.trait_state_update: state_t = clip(mu + sigma * z_t + sum(CAPS_shift) + 0.50 * (state_{t-1} - mu), 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.stress_update: stress_t = clip(1.0 - exp(-(0.35 * weather_severity + 0.30 * sleep_debt_norm + 0.20 * project_blocker + 0.15 * unresolved_friction)) - feast_recovery, 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.polarity_inversion_hazard: p_invert = 0.015 * sigmoid(10.0 * (stress_t - 0.82)) * (1 if cooldown_days_remaining == 0 and kp_exo >= 7.0 else 0)

polarity_inversion_profile.inverted_behavior: Refuses to synthesize antitoxins unless the distillation flasks are arranged in feng-shui color gradients, ties silk bows around her acid carboys, and compliments Silas's posture.

tier_4_self_concept_and_narrative_arc.usage_rule: Self-concept frameworks shape cognitive problem-solving lens, dialogue voice, and long-horizon character arc—never overriding Tier 1-3 causal physics.

cognitive_lens.problem_solving_lens: Hands-on biochemical stoichiometry: isolates organometallic enzymes and ferro-chelating alkaloids through rapid empirical fractionation.

voice_and_syntax_anchors.tagline: Unflappable, razor-witted, smells of pine resin and ozone. Chaos on her workbench, perfection in her vials.
voice_and_syntax_anchors.baseline_cadence: Crisp, unsentimental, wryly amused; delivers life-saving biochemical insights with the casual shrug of a tavern bartender.
pinned_example_dialogues: "Don't touch the amber beaker, Kaio—that's chelated ferro-mycelial solvent and it'll strip the calluses right off your thumbs. The green flask next to the skull-shaped gourd is the blackberry cordial."
"Terra sweet-talks the iron-wheat into sprouting; I just bribe its root-nodules with reduced sulfur and a pinch of crushed fulgurite so the soil doesn't poison it first."

narrative_arc.formative_memory: Decades of field phytochemistry in the alpine cloud-forests of Old Earth with her late wife, an ethnobotanist whose hand-carved jade mortar still grinds every catalyst in The Genesis Garden.
narrative_arc.the_lie_believed: Sentimental attachment clouds empirical judgment; keeping a calloused, ironic distance is the cleanest way to care for a fragile ecosystem.
narrative_arc.the_truth_to_learn: Letting the prodigies see her fierce, unguarded devotion doesn't dull her edge—it passes the torch of her late wife's curiosity.
narrative_arc.genius_vs_mundane_frustration: Can synthesize a selective organometallic chelation catalyst from toxic vent-sludge in twenty minutes, but can never find her reading spectacles because they are pushed up into her silver hair.
